Mike Trees found that he had Belgrave company in the form of Kevin Nash for his local 5 miler. Hoping to get into shape to make the A team for the SEAA 12-Stage, our veteran World 10k Champ from a couple of years back hung on to Nasher for as long as he could, just fading away over the last part of the race.

Mike Trees was 5th (1st Veteran – and good to see him running again after a severe dental operation) in 54:55, Joachim Wolf 7th in 55:21 – and the Bels were first team.
Also planning to be involved is Mike Trees, World Masters 10km Road Running Champion from a couple of years back and regularly placed in the very top section of the World Duathlon Rankings.
